'''Ryleah''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Imperial agent who served in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Stationed in the [[Network Security District]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], she tasked an Imperial spacer to sabotage the Republic's demonstration on new battle droids to use in battling the Empire.
